text:
zoe: Uploaded a new compact roles mock + invite drawer tweaks: https://figma.com/file/NEW-ROLE-MOCK

zoe: Main asks: SSO label copy, reduce tabbable items in rows, and make audit filters survive nav/back.

kai: Compact looks great. Replace multiple permission chips with one "Preview" button per row so keyboard users have a single target. Use `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`.

mina: SSO copy: please change from 'Enforce SSO' to 'Require SSO for org sign-in' and add helper: 'Existing sessions remain signed in; new sign-ins require your IdP.' Put helper in aria-describedby.

ryan: Invite CTA needs clarity. Suggest dynamic: default "Invite users" -> when selection known "Invite 3 users and assign roles". Avoid surprises.

mina: There's a focus trap repro in invite drawer when opening role details. QA flagged it. We should trap focus and close nested panels on Esc in reverse order.

qa-bot: QA steps attached as QA-9123. Repro on Chrome/Win and Safari/Mac. Filters reset when returning to Audit log.

kai: For hover previews, ensure keyboard and touch fallbacks: Preview button for keyboard, chevron tap for touch. Don't rely on hover-only.

zoe: Action items:
- update SSO label + helper + aria-describedby (mina)
- swap chips for single Preview button per row with aria attributes (kai)
- dynamic invite CTA (ryan)
- fix invite-drawer focus trap and Esc behavior (eng/qa ticket QA-9123)
- persist audit filters via URL params (eng)

zoe: Can design deliver one compact screen with the Preview button + SSO helper copy by EOD so eng can estimate?

design-bot: Created PROD-5888: "Roles compact: Preview button, SSO helper copy, invite CTA" and assigned to eng-ux.

ryan: I'll prototype the CTA copy in the component playground and link it to PROD-5888.

mina: I'll draft the aria-describedby string and post it in the ticket.

zoe: Thanks everyone, will update Figma and link back here. :white_check_mark:
